subject: Luminary pilot — success guardrails, KPI framework & ops checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom@luminary.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2024 15:13:00 -0800
Subject: Luminary pilot — success guardrails, KPI framework & ops checklist

Tom / Elena — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps for the pilot so we have alignment before Ben jumps into the technical kickoff.

TL;DR: Redwood proposes a 3-week sandbox (safety + instrumentation) followed by a 2-week controlled pilot. Primary gating metrics: latency (p50/p95), sustained throughput, cost/token, and human-rated quality on your sample queries. Owners & acceptance criteria below. Please confirm and flag anything missing.

1) Success criteria (proposal)
- Latency: p50 <= 180 ms, p95 <= 700 ms for 2k token context on your typical request mix.
- Throughput: sustained 40 requests/sec at 95% availability during business hours (with spikes to 80 rps for 60s allowed).
- Cost: target gross cost <= $0.12 per 1k tokens for inference (we include quantized model option in attachment).
- Quality: automated checks + human review (5 business reviewers) with weighted metric: 90% of sampled responses >= 4/5 on your rubric OR task-specific accuracy (e.g., extraction F1 >= 0.87).

2) Evaluation plan & instrumentation
- Redwood will run the pilot in your sandbox VPC (private deployment option).
- Deliverables: telemetry dashboard (latency percentiles, tokens/s, cache hit-rate), token-level cost breakdown, and daily quality spot checks via shared doc.
- Dataset: use the sample queries you shared; please add an "edge_cases.csv" row set for hallucination checks.

3) Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and data access; exchange security questionnaire items.
- Week 1: infra setup + small smoke tests; baseline latency/throughput.
- Week 2: workload ramp to target throughput; begin quality annotation.
- Week 3: controlled pilot runs, cost estimation, ops runbook creation.
- Decision: end of Week 5 – go/no-go + recommended configuration (quantization, batching, routing).

4) Owners
- Redwood sales lead: Irene Choi (me) — commercial questions / timeline.
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — technical integration, perf tuning.
- Customer PM: Tom Alvarez — trial owner and dataset curator.
- Customer engineering: Elena Ruiz — sandbox access & infra liaison.

5) Action items (Irene/Redwood)
- Share pilot outline + cost estimate (attached).
- Schedule 30-min technical kickoff with Ben + your infra team (proposed Thursday).
- Provision a small sample dataset to /Drive folder linked below.

Attachments: luminary_poc-outline.pdf (POC plan), token_cost_estimate.xlsx (cost model), luminary_sample_queries.csv (placeholder).

If this matches your expectations, I’ll have Ben send a short technical checklist and propose Thursday/Friday morning for the kick-off.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Tom Alvarez <tom@luminary.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@luminary.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Nov 2024 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Luminary pilot — success guardrails, KPI framework & ops checklist

Irene — this is great, thanks for the clear plan. A couple quick clarifications from our side after internal sync: 

- Throughput: our primary concern is sustained throughput during batch ingestion windows (we have periodic hourly spikes around 200 rps for 90s). Can we include a burst handling SLA and a fallback routing plan if capacity is saturated?
- Latency: the p95 target looks OK, but can we test a 4k token scenario as well for a subset of requests? Some of our summarization jobs use longer contexts.
- Cost: $0.12 per 1k tokens would be excellent — can you include an estimate for the quantized vs fp16 option and the expected latency delta?
- Security: we'll need a filled copy of your SOC2 evidence checklist and a standard BAA — I’ll forward our security contact if needed.

I attached the initial sample_queries.csv (first-pass) and a short list of our "edge cases" we want to lock down.

We can do Thursday 11/7 at 10:00 PT for the tech kickoff — Elena will join. Confirm Ben can do that time and we’ll accept a calendar invite.

—Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of ML Engineering, Luminary AI
tom@luminary.ai

Attachments: luminary_sample_queries.csv (provided by customer)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom@luminary.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Nov 2024 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Luminary pilot — success guardrails, KPI framework & ops checklist

Thanks Tom — Thursday 11/7 10:00 PT works for me, I’ve sent the calendar invite.

A few technical notes so the kickoff can be focused: 
- Burst handling: Redwood supports policy-based routing. For the pilot we recommend configuring a burst tier that holds short-duration spikes up to 220 rps with graceful degradation to a lower-cost model shard if needed. We’ll exercise this during ramp tests.
- 4k context tests: we’ll include a 4k token test suite for 10% of requests; expect ~1.8x latency on p50/p95 depending on model selection. We’ll document exact numbers in runbook.
- Quantization tradeoffs: attached cost_estimate has separate rows for 8-bit LLMXQ, 4-bit INT4 and FP16. Typically latency improves slightly with quantization but model-dependent; we’ll measure at ramp.
- Security & compliance: Monica (cc) will share the SOC2 evidence pack and our redacted network diagram. Please send your security contact for the BAA.

Pilot checklist (short):
- Customer provides sandbox VPC CIDR + temporary test credentials.
- Customer uploads sample_queries.csv to the Drive folder.
- Redwood sets up metrics dashboard + instrumentation hooks (token-level, cache-hit, error-rate).
- Schedule 1-hour quality annotation session on Week 2.

I’ll bring a short perf-validation script to the kickoff that runs baseline load and collects p50/p95. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Principal SE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: perf_smoke_script.sh (referenced), token_cost_estimate.xlsx (redwood cost breakdown)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@luminary.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@luminary.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 Nov 2024 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Luminary pilot — success guardrails, KPI framework & ops checklist

Ben / Irene — quick confirm from us: we reviewed the attachments and the proposed guardrails and are good to proceed with the timeline. Two small asks before the kickoff: 

1) Please include a short paragraph in the SOW that defines the "go/no-go" acceptance decision (we want an explicit decision checklist).
2) We have a procurement request to discuss a small onboarding credit for the pilot if the metrics are met; can you include a note on standard pilot credits and who signs off?

Monica — looping you for SOC2 handoff. Tom — talk Thursday.

Thanks,
Elena
Engineering Manager, Luminary AI
elena@luminary.ai
